purpose: Freeze the only approved exclusion from Phase 03 distillation/training input without changing the Phase 01 IT Train file.
rule: Exclude a source only when its no-truncation token count exceeds the fixed Student encoder positional capacity. Do not truncate, segment, rewrite, or otherwise modify the source.
not_a_runtime_policy: This policy applies only to Phase 03 training data. Phase 04 must separately define any handling of user inputs longer than the accepted Main-Core capacity.
